summaries.title: Let the Expert Stick to His Last: Expert-Specialized Fine-Tuning for Sparse Architectural Large Language Models
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Let the Expert Stick to** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、混合专家架构（Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)），并引入 Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this work, we study the PEFT method for LLMs with the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture and the contents of this work are mainly threefold: (1) We investigate the...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用稀疏专家路由与解耦表征设计。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：In this work, we study the PEFT method for LLMs with the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture and the contents of this work are mainly threefold:...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（(2) We propose Expert-Specialized Fine-Tuning, or ESFT, which tunes the experts most relevant to downstream tasks...；We find that MoE models with finer-grained experts are more advantageous in selecting the combination of experts...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 46 赞，出自 DeepSeek），本工作为突破 **混合专家与动态深度 (MoE/MoD)、监督微调与参数高效适配 (SFT/LoRA)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Diffusion Forcing: Next-token Prediction Meets Full-Sequence Diffusion

summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Project website:）。

summaries.title: Planetarium: A Rigorous Benchmark for Translating Text to Structured Planning Languages
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于评测基准与数据集。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Planetarium** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖推理与测试时计算（Reasoning & TTC）。核心论点主张：To bridge this gap, we introduce \benchmarkName, a benchmark designed to evaluate language models' ability to generate PDDL code from natural language descriptions of...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To bridge this gap, we introduce \benchmarkName, a benchmark designed to evaluate language models' ability to generate PDDL code from natural language descriptions...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **87.6%, 82.2%, 35.1%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（For example, 87.6% of the PDDL problem descriptions generated by GPT-4o are syntactically parseable, 82.2% are valid, solve-able problems, but only 35.1% are semantically correct,...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 20 赞，出自 Bats Research），本工作可作为评估 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
